<!--
  The gallery hero (model gallery@1): an optional badge, the heading, a description, up to two links as the
  actions and three or four photos as a list. Axes: media (end: the photos after the copy, start: before it from
  md up, bottom: in a row under it), count (3: three square photos in a row, 4: a 2 x 2 grid, a row of four
  under the copy).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { GalleryPhoto } from "./gallery-hero.types";

  export type GalleryHeroProps = {
    id: string;
    badge?: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    actionLabel?: string;
    actionHref?: string;
    secondaryActionLabel?: string;
    secondaryActionHref?: string;
    photos: GalleryPhoto[];
    level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
    padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
    align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
    media?: "end" | "start" | "bottom";
    count?: "3" | "4";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../compose/Badge.svelte";
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    badge = "",
    title,
    description = "",
    actionLabel = "",
    actionHref = "",
    secondaryActionLabel = "",
    secondaryActionHref = "",
    photos,
    level = 2,
    padding = "standard",
    align = "start",
    media = "end",
    count = "3",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: GalleryHeroProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");
  const column = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
    : "start"
  );
  const textAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
    : "text-start"
  );
  const frame = $derived(
    (media as string) === "bottom" ? "grid grid-cols-1 gap-12"
    : "grid grid-cols-1 items-center gap-12 md:grid-cols-2"
  );
  const photoCols = $derived(
    ((media as string) === "bottom") && ((count as string) === "4") ? "grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4"
    : (count as string) === "4" ? "grid-cols-2"
    : "grid-cols-3"
  );
  const photoOrder = $derived(((media as string) === "start") ? "md:order-first" : "");
  const photoRatio = $derived(
    (media as string) === "bottom" ? "4/3"
    : (count as string) === "4" ? "4/3"
    : "1/1"
  );
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={
    (padding as string) === "compact" ? "py-8 lg:py-16"
    : (padding as string) === "spacious" ? "py-24 lg:py-40"
    : "py-16 lg:py-32"
  }
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  data-slot="gallery-hero"
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Box class={frame}>
      <Stack gap="6" align={column}>
        {#if badge}
          <Badge variant="secondary">
            {badge}
          </Badge>
        {/if}
        <Title as={level} size="4xl" weight="bold" class={cn("tracking-tight", textAlign)} id={titleId}>
          {title}
        </Title>
        {#if description}
          <Text size="lg" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", textAlign)}>
            {description}
          </Text>
        {/if}
        {#if ((actionLabel && actionHref) || (secondaryActionLabel && secondaryActionHref))}
          <Group gap="4" align="center" justify={column} class="flex-wrap">
            {#if (actionLabel && actionHref)}
              <LinkButton variant="default" size="lg" href={urlOf(actionHref)}>
                {actionLabel}
              </LinkButton>
            {/if}
            {#if (secondaryActionLabel && secondaryActionHref)}
              <LinkButton variant="secondary" size="lg" href={urlOf(secondaryActionHref)}>
                {secondaryActionLabel}
              </LinkButton>
            {/if}
          </Group>
        {/if}
      </Stack>
      <List tag="ul" class={cn("m-0 list-none p-0", cn("grid items-start gap-4", photoCols, photoOrder))}>
        {#each photos as p (p.id)}
          <ListItem data-slot="photo">
            <MediaFrame alt={p.imageAlt} src={p.image} ratio={photoRatio} />
          </ListItem>
        {/each}
      </List>
    </Box>
  </Container>
</Block>
